scenario.title: Asking a Former Coworker for Advice
scenario.description: Until last year, you worked with Jordan at a marketing agency, and Jordan has since moved to a company that you are now very interested in. You recently saw a job opening there, but the posting asks for experience with software you have never used.
scenario.subject: Catching up and a quick question
scenario.purpose: Reconnect with a former colleague and ask for advice about a job application
keyPoints: Recall something positive about working together
Explain your concern about the job requirements
Ask for advice or suggest a way to talk about it

modelAnswer:
Hi Jordan,

It has been far too long! I still think about the product launch we managed together two springs ago. Staying late to finish those presentations was exhausting, but I learned so much from the way you kept everyone calm and organized.

I am writing because I noticed that your company is hiring a digital campaign coordinator, and the role sounds like a perfect fit for me. My only worry is that the listing mentions a data analysis program I have never had the chance to use. I am a fast learner, but I am not sure how heavily the team relies on it day to day.

Would you have time for a short phone call or coffee next week? I would love to hear your honest opinion about whether I should apply, and of course I am curious to hear how you are doing.

All the best,
Sam

rubric.description: Reconnects warmly, states the concern about the requirement clearly, and makes a specific request.
Moves naturally from shared memory to purpose to request; appropriate opening and closing.
Semi-formal, friendly register suited to a former colleague; idiomatic and varied language.
